mcp.name: ai
mcp.description: Operational insight into the AI agent framework: available models and AI spend.

tool.name: get_ai_spend
tool.title: Get AI Spend
tool.description: Total LLM cost, tokens and run count, optionally filtered by agent name, user or date range, and optionally grouped by agent or user.

tool.name: list_knowledge_topics
tool.title: List Knowledge Topics
tool.description: The playbooks and reference topics this server offers: each topic's name and a description of when to use it. Call it before a task that takes more than one tool call, then read a topic that fits with get_knowledge_topic and follow it.

tool.name: get_knowledge_topic
tool.title: Get Knowledge Topic
tool.description: One playbook or reference topic by the name list_knowledge_topics gives, as markdown: the steps, the checks to make before any change, and which tools to use.

tool.name: list_ai_models
tool.title: List AI Models
tool.description: The LLM providers and models this system can use, with the configured defaults.
